title: Comparison of Regenerative Potential of Platelet -rich Fibrin Alone and in Combination with Bovine Bone Graft in Intraosseous Defect by Single Flap Approach: A Clinical and Radiographic Study
authors: Thakkar B, Chandran S, Vishnoi S, Nadig P, Raval R, Doshi P. J Int Soc Prev Community Dent. 2020 Nov 24;10(6):743-751. doi: 10.4103/jispcd.JISPCD_200_19.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “PRF in combination with bovine bone graft was more effective in the treatment of intrabony defects” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
